voices.note: הצדוקין אומרים -- real commits, defeated by the chachamim's כאשר זמם
אמרו להם חכמים (5b.9); שהרי אמרו חכמים (5b.18)
אמר אביו: בני, לאו קל וחומר הוא?
the דתניא of 5b.11-14, the sister-verse proof of both meta-principles

props.gloss_en: conspiring witnesses are not executed unless the accused's verdict had been finalised before their hazama
the tzedukim: they are executed only once the accused has actually been executed
the tzedukim's prooftext: 'a life for a life' -- no life was yet taken
the chachamim's ground: the Torah punishes the SCHEME -- כאשר זמם is written of a brother still alive, so execution of the accused cannot be the trigger

the mishnah's own entertained construal: perhaps they are executed from the moment their testimony was accepted. Refuted in place: ת"ל נפש תחת נפש -- the verse the tzedukim misread is reallocated to teach the gmar-din threshold
the mishnah's reallocation of the tzedukim's verse: נפש תחת נפש teaches the gmar-din prerequisite itself
Bribbi: if the accused was not yet executed, the zomemin are executed
Bribbi: if the accused WAS executed on their word, the zomemin are not executed -- the ruling the father's kal vachomer runs against

no punishment is imposed on the strength of an inference alone: the full-sister penalty was derivable a fortiori, yet the Torah wrote ערות אחותו גלה -- the redundancy teaches that the kal vachomer may not ground punishment. The counterfactual KV rides HERE, not as a live middah (header)
and no scriptural warning is constituted by an inference alone: the azhara-side twin, taught by the redundancy of ערות בת אשת אביך
the punishment verse names the half-sister on either side (Vayikra 20:17 -- NOT the Yevamot verse isha_el_achota, Vayikra 18:18)
the full sister's punishment comes from the verse's own closing words -- written although the KV stood ready, which is the whole proof
the warning verse for the half-sister (Vayikra 18:9)
the full sister's warning from Vayikra 18:11 -- again written although the azhara-KV stood ready

the question's presupposition (Rashi: העידוהו שחייב מלקות והוזמו): witnesses who schemed malkot are themselves lashed -- the law sanhedrin_10a derives from והצדיקו; here it is premise, not conclusion (frozen-delta in header)
the gmar-din prerequisite extends to malkot-liable hazama by the rasha-rasha gezera shava -- the same schema sanhedrin_10a's R' Yishmael wields
and to galut-liable hazama by ratzach-ratzach (Rashi: their penalty is malkot but not from כאשר זמם, so רשע-רשע -- written of the condemned -- cannot carry it)
R' Yehuda ben Tabai's deed and its embodied ruling: a single convicted zomem may be executed (to refute the tzedukim's עד שיהרג). Retracted at 5b.19

the chachamim's rule Shimon ben Shatach cites: no execution (and no lashes) unless BOTH witnesses were proven zomemin. Encoded with requires/2, not din/2: it is a further condition beside gmar din, not a rival ruling (header, negative control)
R' Yehuda ben Tabai's proof that the graveside voice was his own penance, not the executed witness: when I die tomorrow the voice will cease

schemas.gloss_en: בני, לאו קל וחומר הוא? -- if witnesses whose scheme claimed no life are executed, those whose scheme killed all the more so. Formally flawless; barred because its conclusion is a punishment

restricted_by.gloss_en: אין עונשין מן הדין: where the kal vachomer's conclusion would impose a punishment, the inference is barred -- לימדתנו רבינו, proven at 5b.12 from ערות אחותו גלה (= p_ein_onshin)

schemas.gloss_en: תלמוד לומר רשע רשע: נאמר והיה אם בן הכות הרשע במלקות ונאמר אשר הוא רשע למות במיתה -- as capital hazama waits for gmar din (נפש תחת נפש), so malkot hazama
אתיא רצח רצח: נאמר מות יומת המכה רוצח הוא במיתה ונאמר לנוס שמה רוצח בגלות

challenges.gloss_en: אמר ליה רב אחא בריה דרבא לרב אשי: דלמא בדינא קם בהדיה, אי נמי פיוסי פייסיה -- the voice's ceasing at his death admits other causes, so the proof does not bind

objections.gloss_en: והלא כבר נאמר ועשיתם לו כאשר זמם לעשות לאחיו -- והרי אחיו קיים: the penalty attaches to the scheme while the brother lives, so it cannot wait upon his death
אראה בנחמה אם לא שפכת דם נקי: only one of the pair had been proven zomem, and אין העדים זוממין נהרגין עד שיזומו שניהם
